violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: Chemical sanitizer immersion time was not adequate for sanitizing solution. Rubber pitchers were not observed sanitized after the rinse step, at the 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Chemical sanitization (manual or mechanical operations) including the application of sanitizing chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods using a solution by providing: 1) an exposure time of at least 10 seconds for a chlorine solution, 2) an exposure time of at least 7 seconds for a chlorine solution of 50mg/L that has a pH of 10 or less and a water temperature of 100F or a pH of 8 or less and a water temperature of 75F, 3) an exposure time of at least 30 seconds for other chemical sanitizing solutions, or 4) an exposure time used in relationship with a combination of temperature, concentration, and pH that when evaluated for efficacy yields sanitization. Food contact utensils must be washed, rinsed and sanitized each time, at the 3-compartment sink. Do not skip the sanitizing step. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: while milk=47F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. Milk was discarded at the time of the inspection.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. Employee observed wearing bracelet and a watch while prepare timing food in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at the restroom handwashing sink used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SLICED ROASTED PORK=47F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. ROASTED PORK WAS DICARDED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device(Thermometer).
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food supplies stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor in the front serving area and at the back work areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Kokee (Inspection Date: 04/07/2025) Page 2 of 3
